home.heroTitle: Modern IPTV Player for TV and Smartphone
home.heroSubtitle: Fast, resilient, and user-friendly player for live TV, electronic program guides, and archives. No ads, no trackers.
home.playerNoticeTitle: Please Note: YAiPlayer is strictly a player
home.playerNoticeText: The application contains no built-in TV channels, movies, or media content. You connect your own playlists (M3U), Xtream Codes provider access, or Stalker/Ministra portals.
home.f1Desc: Support for M3U/M3U8 playlists, Xtream Codes API, and Stalker/Ministra portals (via MAC address or user credentials).
home.f2Desc: Built-in XMLTV electronic program guide, convenient channel grid, live preview, and fast access to catchup archives.
home.f3Desc: Purpose-built interfaces: oversized D-Pad navigation for TV remotes and fluid touch gestures for smartphone displays.
home.f4Desc: Zero embedded advertising, zero analytics, zero trackers. Connections flow directly to your chosen IPTV provider servers.
home.soonSubtitle: These features are not yet active on the site and will be introduced in upcoming releases:
home.soon1Desc: Unified list of sources, favorite channels, and watch history across smartphone, TV box, and web portal.
home.soon2Title: TV Pairing via PIN or QR
home.soon2Desc: Quick pairing on your television without typing long URLs on a remote — enter a 6-digit code or scan a QR code.
home.soonNotice: Honestly stated: features are currently in active development. Today the player is completely standalone and configured locally.
home.communityText: Follow updates, new releases, and get support through our official Telegram channel and bot.

download.title: Download YAiPlayer
download.subtitle: Choose the build for your Android device. Free and open source software under the GPL-3.0 license.
download.tvDesc: Optimized for televisions, streaming boxes, and remote control (D-Pad) navigation.
download.mobileDesc: Portrait and landscape modes tailored for intuitive touch gestures.
download.installGuideTitle: How to allow installation from unknown sources (3 steps)
download.step1: 1. Download the APK file onto your device using your browser (or transfer via USB flash drive for TV).
download.step2: 2. Open the downloaded file. When prompted by Android security, select «Settings» and enable «Allow from this source».
download.step3: 3. Press Back, tap «Install», and launch YAiPlayer once installation finishes.
download.inAppUpdateText: If YAiPlayer is already installed on your device, navigate to: «About» → «Check for updates». When a new build is detected, it downloads and upgrades automatically.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding player functionality, source setup, and privacy.
faq.q1: Where do I get channels and playlists?
faq.a1: YAiPlayer is strictly a player application. It does not provide any preloaded streams. To watch TV, provide an M3U playlist URL or account credentials from your legal IPTV provider.
faq.q2: Are archives and live TV pause supported?
faq.a2: Yes. If your IPTV provider supports catchup archives (Catchup / Flussonic / Xtream / Stalker), the player automatically displays past broadcast slots inside the EPG view.
faq.q3: How do I connect a Stalker portal?
faq.a3: In the Add Source menu, select «Stalker». Enter the portal URL and provide the MAC address (format 00:1A:79:XX:XX:XX) or account credentials registered with your service provider.
faq.q4: Does the player collect watch history or personal data?
faq.a4: No. The application contains no analytics SDKs, user trackers, or ad engines. Network connections occur directly between your device and your provider servers.
faq.q5: How can I update the app on my TV box?
faq.a5: You can select «About» → «Check for updates» inside the player, or download the latest APK file from the Download section on this website.
faq.q6: How can I report bugs or suggest features?
faq.a6: Join our Telegram channel @YAiPlayer or send a message directly to our support bot @YAiPlayer_bot.
